data.description: The soul bound to the doll lives within a focus integrated into the doll or its apparel, typically one of the doll's eyes or a gem embedded into its neck or chest.  As long as this soul focus remains intact, it can be used to animate another doll, using the same cost as creating a new construct.  Once bound into the soul focus, the soul continues to learn, and so if later it is put into a new doll body, the soul retains its personality and memories from its previous body or bodies.  A soul focus has hardness 8, 12 hit points, and a break DC of 20.
